__name: NPCs joining the battles of the player (BattleEvent) and teaming up (HirePeopleEvent)
__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
JoinRange: cells around the player where NPCs may join.
...JoinRate / TeamMemberBetrayRate: chances in %, checked every second of the battle (0-100).
FriendlyIntim / EnemyIntim: intimacy (250 to -250) from which an NPC helps / attacks the player.
DifferenceRighteous: difference of righteousness (NPC vs player) from which an NPC takes the other side; also the most a friend may differ to team up.
